If air is eliminated, there will be no force of gravity on an object placed in the hole.

When the perpendicular distance h is zero millimetres, the equation leads to an infinite force (F = G(Mm)/0²), but zero is not zero, so it will be below or equal to 0 in terms of its value with g (9.8 m/s²).
